semantics: line_item.variant_id is the canonical historical variant/SKU-level analytical identity.
Product requests roll variants through product_variant.product_id and aggregate by product_id.
Product and variant are different analytical grains and must not be silently substituted.
line_item.title is historical display metadata and must not be part of the analytical grouping key for variant metrics.
product.title and product_variant.title are display metadata and do not define analytical identity.
product_variant.sku is only the literal stored SKU string when explicitly requested; it is not the normal analytical variant key.
Net units sold equals original line_item.quantity minus preaggregated partial cancelled quantity, floored at zero, among qualifying orders.
Fully cancelled orders contribute no qualifying product demand.
Current product and product_variant tables are optional enrichment for historical transaction facts and must not unnecessarily remove historical line items.
Display labels should be selected separately from the metric grouping grain.
Do not allow payment, fulfillment or other one-to-many child joins to multiply line quantities.
